newsitem.title: GERMANY: German ad agency starts data processing unit.
newsitem.headline: German ad agency starts data processing unit.

text.p: German advertising agency Scholz & Friends said on Monday it had launched a subsidiary for digital data processing with a Hamburg lithography company.

The new company, Steinhoeft Pre-Press GmbH, will prepare digital data material for for use in photography, lithography or printing, Scholz & Friends said, and is the product of an alliance with Oluf Stumm Olsen GmbH.
"The decision on the part of Scholz & Friends to move toward production technology is a clear sign from the agency that it is looking toward the future," the agency said in a statement.
